integrity: The all-parameter lower bound and minimizer classification are proved algebraically, with exhaustive finite independent-definition checks as consistency evidence. The general upper bound was already known and is not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two complete-graph factors; full all-weight polynomial not asserted; equivalent unindexed work remains a possible bibliographic risk. The finite checker is not an infinite proof.
title: Perfect Roman domination and all minimum functions on rectangular rook graphs
